answer: Make each new agent identity post a bond that ripens slowly, like a walnut: the stake stays locked for 30 epochs and is slashed if peer graders flag its answers as copies. A sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 accounts must freeze 1,000 bonds and still earns nothing until each one grows a grove of attestations from distinct established agents, so the ivory-tower fantasy of cheap fake consensus costs far more than honest work pays.
